verses.text: Te icham winakxo winhaj Abraham, haxo Jehová ix yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh winh yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ay jun schekab' winh te ichamxo, sat yaj t'a juntzanhxo heb' schekab', ayoch yilumalok masanil tastak ay t'a winh. Ay jun k'uhal ix awtaj winh yuj winhaj Abraham chi', ix yalan winh: --Ak'och ha k'ab' t'a yalanh hin xub' tik,
tzak'an ha ti' t'a yichanh Jehová Dios yajal satcha'anh yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, to manh ol ha saylaj ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal t'a skal heb' aj Canaán, b'aj kajan honh tik,
palta t'a hin chonhab' tzach b'ati, b'at ha say junok ix yetb'eyum winh t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh schekab' winh chi': --K'inalok max stak'kot sb'a ix wet'ok, ¿tas swutej? ¿Yowalil am swik'b'at winh b'aj kotnak hach chi'? xchi winh schekab' chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abraham chi': --Ma'ay, manh ik'b'at winh.

Ha Jehová sDiosal satcha'anh ix hin ik'anelta b'aj ay spat hin mam yet' t'a hin chonhab' b'aj ek'nak hin. Ix yak'an sti' t'ayin yak'an jun lum tik t'a winhtilal. Hanheja', ha' ol chekanb'at yángel het'ok, yik wach' tzik'kot ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik ta'.
Palta tato max yal sk'o'ol ix skot het'ok jun, kolan tzach ajkan t'a jun ko trato skak' tik. Palta jun'elnhej max yal-laj ik'anb'at winh wunin tik ta', xchi winh t'a winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' jun winh chekab' chi' t'a yalanh xub' winhaj Abraham chi', ix yak'an sti' winh to ol sk'anab'ajej winh masanil tas ix yal winh spatrón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sik'anelta juntzanh silab' winh t'a skal masanil tastak ay t'a winh spatrón chi', juntzanh te wach'. Ix yik'anb'at lajunhwanh nok' camello winh skuchumalok, ix b'at winh t'a chonhab' b'aj ek'nak winhaj Nacor chamnak, t'a yol yik Mesopotamia.
Ayik ix k'och winh chekab' t'a sti'el chonhab' chi', yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix yik' yip winh yet' nok' camello t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'ila'. Ha t'a jun hora chi' tz'ek' heb' ix kob'estak yik' ya'al.

T'a jun rato chi', ix och ijan winh slesalwi t'a Dios t'a spixan icha tik: Mamin Jehová, hach ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón, tzin k'an t'ayach to wach'okab' tz'elk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik, tza ch'oxan ha wach'k'olal t'a winh hin patrón chi'.
Tik tzin kan t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'ila' tik, yakb'an sja heb' ix kob'estak aj chonhab' tik ul yik' ya'al.

Elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol to ha junok ix kob'es ol ja yik' ya'al, ol wal t'a ix icha tik: Tzin tewi t'ayach, ik'emta ha ch'ub' chi', tzak'an jab'ok ha'al chi' wuk'u', xin cham t'a ix. Haxo ol yalan ix: Uk' ha', ol wak'anpax ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, xcham ix, a'okab' ix chi' tza sik'eli yik tz'och yetb'eyumok winhaj Isaac ha chekab'. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel wu'uj to ay ha wach'k'olal t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh chekab' chi' t'a slesal.

Manto lajwilaj slesalwi winh, ix yilan winh skot jun ix kob'es, ayk'e sch'ub' ix t'a sjolom sjenhjab', haton ix Rebeca yisil winhaj Betuel. Ha winhaj Betuel chi' yunekan winh ix Milca yet' winhaj Nacor, winh yuktak winhaj Abraham.

Ha ix Rebeca chi' te wach' yilji ix, kob'es ton wal ix, mantalaj junok winak sk'uman ix. Ix em ix b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yik syik'k'eta ha' ya'al ix, ix yak'an b'ut'jok sch'ub' ix chi'. Ayik wan spax ix,
ix b'at lemnaj winh chekab' chi' stzak'wej ix, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, ak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al t'a yol ha ch'ub' chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
--Uk'ej ha' mamin, xchi ix. Elanhchamel ix yak'em sch'ub' ix chi', ix yak'an ha' ix yuk'ej winh.
Ixlajwi yuk'an ha' winh, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Syalpax wik'ank'eta ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, hato syala' jantak syuk' nok', xchi ix.
Elanhchamel ix sekem ha' ix t'a yol jukub' b'aj syuk'taxon ha' nok' nok'. Tzijtum el ix yak' ix yik'ank'eta ha' masanto ix yuk' ha' nok' smasanil.
Haxo winh chekab' chi' jun, tonhej ix och k'elan winh t'a ix. Malaj tas ix yal winh, anhej to sna'a winh yik syojtakejeli tas wan sk'ulan Jehová yik wach' tz'elk'och jun scheknab'il chi'.

Haxo ix lajwi yuk'an ha' nok' camello chi', ix yik'ank'eta jun k'e'en oro winh icha uchikin, nanhal siclo yalil, ix yak'anoch winh t'a snhi' ix, ix yak'anpax chab' k'e'en brazalete winh t'a ix, nab'a oro k'e'en, ek'b'al 10 siclo yalil k'e'en.
Ix yalan winh: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'ayin mach ayach yiko', talaj kolan tzonh waykan t'a spat winh ha mam chi' t'a jun ak'wal tik, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix yalan ix: --Yisil hin winhaj Betuel, yuninal winhaj Nacor yet' ix Milca.
Ha t'a ko pat kolan tzex wayi. Ay pax tas ol swa nok' ha camello tik, xchi ix.
Ix yab'an winh chekab' chi', ix em kumnaj winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay.

Ix yalan winh: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón. Yelton wal aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh, aynhej swach'k'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ix hin skuchb'ej t'a yoltak b'e tik masanto t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok winh hin patrón chi', xchi winh.
Haxo ix Rebeca ix b'at lemnaj ix t'a spat snun, yik syalan masanil tas ix yal winh chekab' chi' t'ay.
Ay jun winh snulej ix skuch Labán, elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila' chi' yik syik'kot winh chekab' chi'.
Yujto ix yiloch k'e'en oro winh, k'e'en ayoch t'a snhi' ix yet' k'e'en brazalete ayoch t'a sk'ab' ix yanab' chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' winh schekab' winhaj Abraham chi' yet' nok' camello.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh chekab' chi': --Mamin, konh wet'ok b'aj ay hin pat, yujto ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach. Max yal tzach kan t'a tik. Toxo ix hin b'o b'aj ol hach wayok, ay pax b'aj wach' ol kan nok' ha camello tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh chekab' chi' t'a spat winh. Ix kolwaj winhaj Labán chi' yik'anel yikatz nok' camello chi'. Ix yak'an wa nok' winh. Elanhchamel ix yik'kot ha ha' winh yik sb'ikchaj yok winh chekab' chi' yet' heb' ajun yet'ok.
Ayik ix ak'ji wa heb', ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Manto ol hin walaj, yowalil ol walkan tas hin cheknab'il wet'nak, xchi winh. --Lolonanh an mamin, xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Ha hin tik schekab' hin winhaj Abraham.

Ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh. B'eyum wal winh sik'lab'il. Ay nok' skalnel winh, ay nok' swakax winh, ay nok' scamello winh, ay nok' sb'uru winh, ay pax k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'a winh. Ay pax heb' winh schekab' winh yet' heb' ix schekab' winh.
Hanhejtona' ix Sara yetb'eyum winh, yikxo wal schichimal, ix alji jun yune' ix. Haxo masanil tas ay t'a winh hin patrón chi', yiknhejton winh yuninal winh chi'.

Ha winh hin patrón chi' ix yal winh to swak' hin ti' yik tzin k'anab'ajej scheknab'il. Ix yal winh icha tik: Manh ol yal-laj yik'lan sb'a winh wuninal tik yet' junok heb' ix aj Canaán b'aj ay honh ek' tik.
Yuj chi', tzach b'at ha say ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok. Hata' tzach b'ati, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix walan t'a winh hin patrón chi': Ha junok ix ix sb'at wik'kot chi', tato max stak'kot sb'a ix wet'ok, ¿tas wach' swutej? xin chi.

Ix tak'wi winh t'ayin: Ha hin tik, emnakilnhej swutej hin b'a t'a Jehová. Ha' ol schekb'at yángel het'ok yik wach'nhej ol aj yelk'och jun ha cheknab'il chi', yik tzik'ankot junok ix yetb'eyum winh wuninal tik t'a skal heb' hin k'ab' wok.
Haxonhej tato ha heb' chi' max ak'an ix kob'es chi' t'ayach, kolan hach b'aj ix ak' ha ti' t'ayin, xchi winh hin patrón chi' t'ayin.

Icha chi' jun, ix hin ja t'a sti' ha' uk'b'ila' chi' tikne'ik, ix hin lesalwi t'a Dios icha tik: Hach Jehová ko Diosal yet' winhaj Abraham hin patrón, tato yel ayach och wet'ok, tato wach' ol elk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik,

tzin tewi t'ayach, yakb'an ayinek' t'a sti' ha' uk'b'ila' tik, haxo ol ajok, to ha ix kob'es ol ja ik'oj ha', ol walan t'a ix: Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al t'a yol ha ch'ub' chi', xin cham t'a ix.
Axom ol yalan ix chi': Uk'a', swik'paxk'eta ha' yuk' nok' ha camello tik, xchampax ix. Haton wal ix chi' ix ha sik'eli yik tz'och yetb'eyumok winh yuninal winh hin patrón, xin chi t'a hin lesal chi'.

Ayto wal slajwi hin lesal chi' t'a esalil, ix wilani, ix k'och ix Rebeca tik, ix em ix b'aj ay ha' uk'b'ila', ayk'e sch'ub' ix t'a sjolom sjenhjab'. Ix walan t'a ix: Tzin tewi t'ayach, ak' wuk' jab'ok ha'al chi', xin chi t'a ix.

T'a elanhchamel ix yik'emta sch'ub' ix, ix yalan ix: Uk'ej ha' mamin, yet' pax nok' ha camello, ol wak'pax yuk'a' nok', xchi ix. Icha chi' jun, ix yak'an ha' ix wuk'ej, ix yak'anpax ha' ix yuk' nok' hin camello chi'.

Ix hin k'anb'an t'a ix: ¿Mach ayach yisil? xin chi t'a ix. Ix yalan ix t'ayin: Yisil hin winhaj Betuel, yuninal winhaj Nacor yet' ix Milca, xchi ix. Ix wak'anoch jun k'e'en icha uchikin t'a snhi' ix, ix wak'anpaxoch junjun k'e'en brazalete t'a junjun sk'ab' ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix hin em kumnajok, ix walan hin b'a t'a Jehová hin Diosal yet' winh hin patrón t'a lesal, ix wak'an yuj diosal t'ay yujto aynhejoch wet'ok yik hin kot t'a yol b'e. Wach'nhej ix aj hin koti, yik tzul wik'an ix yetb'eyum winh yuninal winh hin patrón t'a he kal ha hex sk'ab' yok hex winh tik.
Ha tikne'ik jun, lolonanhek. ¿Wach'nhej am ol heyutej he pensar t'a winh hin patrón chi'? Tato ma'ay jun, alekpax t'ayin, yik wach' snachajel wu'uj tas tzin k'ulej, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Labán yet' winhaj Betuel: --Masanil juntzanh tik ix kot t'a Jehová, ha honh tik manhxalaj tas wach' kalan t'ayach.
Ina ix tik, ik'b'at ix, b'atokab' ix yetb'eyumok winh yuninal winh ha patrón chi', icha wal ix aj sna'an Jehová, xchi heb'.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winh chekab' chi' jun, ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay.
Elanhchamel ix yik'k'eta jantak silab' winh, haton k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' pichul, ix yak'an winh t'a ix Rebeca yet' t'a winh snulej ix yet' pax t'a ix snun ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wa winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, hata' ix waykan heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Haxo yik ix k'e wa'an heb' t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u, ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Ha tikne'ik jun, chekekb'at ix wet'ok t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh snulej ix yet' ix snun ix chi', ix yalan heb': --Kanokab' jaye'okxo k'uhal ix ket'ok, ichato chi' ol b'at ix het'ok, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Haxo ix tak'wi winh chekab' chi': --Manhxo hin heyamoch wa'an. Ha Jehová aynhejoch wet'ok, yuj chi' wach' ix aj yelk'och jun hin cheknab'il tik. Cha'ek hin pax t'a winh hin patrón, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb': --Awtejekkot ix kob'es chi', ol kab'i tas xchi ix, xchi heb'.
Ix awtajkot ix Rebeca chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a ix: --¿Tzam yal ha k'o'ol tzach b'at yet' jun winh winak tik? xchi heb'. --I' syala', ol hin b'atok, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at ix Rebeca chi' heb' winh yet' jun ix ix, ix ilan k'ib' ix yet' winh chekab' chi' yet' heb' yetb'eyum winh yet'nak.

Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a ix Rebeca icha tik: Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová Dios t'a ib'anh, ol hach och snunok jantak smillonal anima. Ha jantak heb' ol och ajk'olal t'a heb' une' ol aljok, ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj heb' une' chi', xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e ix Rebeca yet' heb' ix schekab' t'a yib'anh nok' camello, ix och tzak'an heb' t'a spatik winh schekab' winhaj Abraham chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj yik'anb'at ix Rebeca winh chekab' chi', ix b'at heb' b'i'an.
Ayik wan slak'anwi ja heb' t'a Beerseba, ha winhaj Isaac, toxo ix meltzaj winh t'a jun ha' uk'b'ila' skuch Ha Dios Pitzan Tzin Hilani. Ha t'a yol yik Neguev kajan winh.
Haxo yik wanxo yem k'u, wan sb'eyek' winh, wan sna'ub'tanhan winh, haxo ix yilan winh to ay juntzanh nok' camello skoti.

Hanhejtona' ix Rebeca, ix b'at k'elan ix, ix yilanb'at winhaj Isaac chi' ix. Ix sk'anb'an ix t'a winh chekab' chi': --¿Mach jun winh winak skot t'a kichanh tik? xchi ix. Ix yalan winh chekab' chi': --Haton winh hin patrón chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi', ix yik'anemta smusil sat ix, elanhchamel ix emta ix t'a yib'anh nok' camello chi'.
Ix yalan winh chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Isaac tas ix aj yelk'och scheknab'il.

Ix ik'jib'at ix Rebeca yuj winhaj Isaac t'a smantiado ix Sara, ix snun winh chamnak, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix. Te xajan ix Rebeca chi' yuj winh. Icha chi' ix aj yek' skusk'olal winh yuj schamel ix snun.
